strings.privacy.title: Zviri kuvanzika
strings.privacy.description: Maitiro anoita pdff mafaera ako: hapana nhoroondo, hapana gwaro rinochengetwa, hapana ads uye hapana kutengeswa kwedata.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yakagadzirwa kuitira kuti zvinyorwa zvako zvirambe zviri zvako. Hezvano, nemashoko akareruka, zvinoitika paunenge uchishandisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mafaera ako
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Inotumirwa yakachengetedzwa neencryption (HTTPS), inogadziriswa otomatiki, yobva yabviswa pakarepo kana mhedzisiro yagadzirira. Mafaera makuru anopfuura nenzvimbo yechinguvana pasi pezita risingazivikanwe uye anoputswa pakarepo kana kugadzirisa kwapera; kuchenesa otomatiki kunobvisa chero chinhu chingasara mukati memaawa 24 zvichanyanya.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Hapana nhoroondo, hapana data remunhu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff haikumbiri kunyoresa, kero yeemail kana kadhi rechikwereti. Zvinyorwa zvako hazvimboverengwi, hazviongororwi, hazvigovaniswi kana kushandisirwa kudzidzisa uchenjeri hwekugadzira (artificial intelligence).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kuyera vashanyi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tinoverenga vashanyi pasina kuzivikanwa uye pasina makuki (Vercel Web Analytics) kuti tizive kuti ndedzipi nhengo dzinobatsira. Hapana ads, hapana kutevera kumawebhusaiti akasiyana.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Makuki (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki imwechete, yekuzvidira: inoyeuka mutauro wawasarudza.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kugarisa saiti (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Saiti iyi inochengetwa neVercel pamaseva muParis; shanduro dzeWord, Excel nePowerPoint dzinobata neRender muFrankfurt. Vapangidzi ava vanongobata mafaera panguva yekushandura chete.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Bata nesu
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Mubvunzo kana mhinduro? Bata nesu kubva papeji yeprojekti:
strings.legal.terms.title: Mitemo yekushandisa
strings.legal.terms.description: pdff ndeyemahara kune vese, kusanganisira mabhizinesi nehurumende. Gwaro rako rinoramba riri rako: hapana chinoverengwa kana kuchengetwa.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Mitemo iyi inotonga kushandisa kwako pdff. Yakapfupikiswa nemaune uye yakanyorwa nemutauro unonzwisisika. Nekushandisa saiti iyi, unobvumirana nayo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ndiani anodhinda pdff
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff yakagadzirwa, yakavakwa uye yakabudiswa naMikailou Cedric Toure, muumbi anogara kuNew Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Rezinesi remahara rekushandisa, kune vese
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff ndeyemahara, isina kunyoresa uye isina nguva yakatemwa, kune vese: vanhuwo zvavo, vadzidzi, vadzidzisi, mabhizinesi, masangano asingabatsiri, hurumende, muCanada nakune dzimwe nyika. Hapana chinochengeterwa chirongwa chakabhadharwa, nekuti hapana chakadaro. Mafaira aunogadzira nd europeos ako zvizere: haana zviratidzo kana zita re pdff.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Magwaro ako ese, kunyange akavanzika
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Unogona kushanda nechero gwaro, kusanganisira akavanzika, nekuti pdff haiverenge, haiongorori, haichengete kana kugovana mafaira ako: anogadziriswa otomatiki ozobviswa. Unoramba uri muridzi wawo, uye une mhosva yekuve nekodzero dzinodiwa kuti uzviite.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Kودhi yechibviro nekumisikidza pama server ako
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Kودhi ye pdff inobudiswa pasi pezita re MIT rezinesi. Unogona kuverenga, kuongorora, kuisa pama server ako (kusanganisira pasina Indaneti), kugadzirisa uye kugovera mahara, chero uchichengetedza chiziviso chekodzero.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Kushandisa kunogamuchirwa
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Haukwanisi kushandisa pdff pazvinhu zvisiri pamutemo, kuedza kukanganisa sevhisi kana kudarika miganhu yayo. Saizi nemiganhu yemafaira zvinodzivirira sevhisi kune vese.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Kuvapo
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff inopihwa mahara. Inogona kuchinja, kukanganiswa pakugadzirisa kana kumiswa. Gara wakachengeta magwaro ako ekutanga: pdff haichengete kopi yawo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Garandi nemhosva
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Sevhisi inopiwa “sezvairi”, isina garandi. Muparidzi haatakure mhosva yekuipa kwezvinhu kana kurasikirwa kwedata. Tarisa magwaro aunogadzira usati waisa zvakakosha.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Kodzero dzezviumbwa
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Zita re pdff, logo yayo nemashoko esaiti ndezvemuparidzi; kودhi iri pasi pezita re MIT. Zviratidzo zvinotaurwa (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) ndezvemuridzi wazvo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Mutemo unotonga
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Mitemo iyi inotongwa nemitemo yePurovhinzi yeNew Brunswick nemitemo yeCanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Shanduko
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Mitemo iyi inogona kuvandudzwa. Zuva riri pamusoro peji rinoratidza shanduro iripo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].title: Bata
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Mibvunzo pamusoro pemitemo iyi? Titumire kubva papeji yechirongwa:
strings.legal.security.title: Chengetedzo nedata
strings.legal.security.description: Zvinoitika kumafaira ako pa pdff: kugadzirisa otomatiki, kusatomborova ongororo, kubviswa nekukurumidza, encryption, kuchengeterwa muEurope.
strings.legal.security.intro: Zvinoitika kumafaira ako, panogadzirirwa uye nekuchengetedzwa kwazvo: zvinotsanangurwa zviri nyore kune vese.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Hapana magwaro anochengetwa
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Mafaira ako anogadziriswa otomatiki, obva abviswa pakarepo kana zvapera. Hapana kopi, hapana backup. Kugadzirisa kwezuva nezuva kunodzima mafaira ese.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Hapana kuongorora
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Hapana munhu anoverenga magwaro ako. Hapana zvakachengetwa kana kushandiswa kudzidzisa artificial intelligence. pdff haina maakaunti, haina ads.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Encryption
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Kubatana kwese kwakachengetedzwa (HTTPS) uye saiti inomanikidza encryption (HSTS). Chishandiso cheKuchengetedza chinonyora ma PDF ako ne AES-256; password yawakasarudza haimbochengetwi.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Panogadzirirwa mafaira ako
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Saiti, PDF nemifananidzo: Vercel, Paris data center (France). Word, Excel nePowerPoint: Render, muFrankfurt (Germany). Mafaira anopfuura 4 MB: Vercel Blob storage yenguva pfupi, inobviswa mushure mekushandisa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Matanho ekuchengetedza
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Misoro yekuchengetedza (HSTS), kudzivirira kuiswa mune dzimwe saiti, kero dzenguva pfupi dzisingafungidziri, uye sevhisi inogamuchira zvikumbiro zvine chivande chete.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Kuvanzika nemutemo
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff inobudiswa muNew Brunswick uye inotevera mitemo yeCanada (PIPEDA). Haiunganidze ruzivo rwevanhu: hapana akaunti, hapana kero yeemail, hapana makuki.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kumasangano ane mitemo yakasimba
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Kana mitemo yenyu ichirambira kutumira magwaro kunze, isa pdff pama server enyu. Chirongwa ichi chine mahara, chakavhurika uye chinoshanda pasina Indaneti.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Kuonekwa pachena
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Kودhi yese iri pachena: zvikwata zvenyu zvekuchengetedza zvinogona kuongorora zvese izvi.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Taurira dambudziko rekuchengetedza
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Unofunga kuti wawana dambudziko rekuchengetedza? Zivisa zvakavanzika kubva petafura ye “Security” yechirongwa:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Kwaniso yekuwana
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Chiziviso chekwaniso yekuwana che pdff: WCAG 2.2 level AA chinangwa, matanho aripo, uye maitiro ekumhan'ara dambudziko.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Munhu wese anofanira kukwanisa kushandisa pdff, kusanganisira mapofu kana vane kuona kushoma, vasinganzwe, kana vane kuremara kwemuviri.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Chinangwa chiyero
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff ine chinangwa chekutevedzera Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Mamiriro ekutevedzera
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff inotevedzera zvakati wandei zve WCAG 2.2 level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Zviripo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Saiti yese inoshanda nekhibhodi, ine chinongedzo che “Skip to content”. Kusiyaniswa kwemavara kwakaringana.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Miganhu inozivikanwa
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Kunze kwesarudzo iyoyo, mifananidzo yekushongedza inoramba ichimhanya; inogona kumiswa.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].title: Mhan'ara chipingamupini
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].text: Pane chinonetsa pa saiti iyi here? Tsanangura kubva papeji yechirongwa; tinovavarira kupindura mukati memazuva 10.

Kuverenga kunoitika pamudziyo wako: gwaro rako harina kuiswa online. Muenzaniso wemutauro wakasarudzwa chete (MB shoma) ndiyo inotorwa kamwe chete.
